summary: 11 OU-level steps and 2 account runbook(s): 0 NO-GO, 2 REVIEW, 0 GO. Clear every account's blockers before the OU tree is recreated.

phases.title: Before the move: the OU tree
phases.intro: What has to be settled for the OUs themselves. Every account's own blockers are in its runbook below and have to be cleared first.

phases.title: Before the move: create the new OU tree
phases.intro: Organizations cannot move an OU, so the tree is built again under the new parent with the same attachments before any account moves.

steps.title: Create OU Production under root Root (r-lark)
steps.detail: The source OU Production (ou-lark-prod) keeps existing until its accounts have moved. Note the new ID; the later steps refer to it as <ID of the new Production OU>.

steps.title: Attach to the new Production OU: BACKUP Larkspur-Daily-Backups
steps.detail: Same attachments as the source OU, so the accounts see the same chain below the moved OU once they arrive. The AWS managed defaults are attached automatically.
commands: aws organizations attach-policy --policy-id p-lark0005 --target-id <ID of the new Production OU>

phases.title: The move
phases.intro: Move the accounts one by one into the new OUs. Each account's runbook lists what changes for it.

steps.title: Move larkspur-data-prod (111111111118) from Production (ou-lark-prod) into the new Production OU
steps.detail: Policies attached directly to the account stay with it; from the new OU upwards the chain is the one the simulation evaluated.
commands: aws organizations move-account --account-id 111111111118 --source-parent-id ou-lark-prod --destination-parent-id <ID of the new Production OU>

steps.title: Move larkspur-payments-prod (111111111115) from Production (ou-lark-prod) into the new Production OU
steps.detail: Policies attached directly to the account stay with it; from the new OU upwards the chain is the one the simulation evaluated.
commands: aws organizations move-account --account-id 111111111115 --source-parent-id ou-lark-prod --destination-parent-id <ID of the new Production OU>

phases.title: After the move: checks
phases.intro: Confirm the tree, register it where Control Tower is involved and remove what is left behind.

steps.title: Confirm the new tree under root Root (r-lark) and every account's parent
steps.detail: Every account should list its new OU as parent and the new OUs should carry the attachments from the steps above.

steps.title: Delete the 1 empty source OU(s)
steps.detail: An OU can only be deleted when it is empty, so delete the deepest ones first. Detach nothing by hand: deleting the OU drops its attachments.

steps.title: Collect a fresh snapshot and simulate the new OU against its own parent
steps.detail: With the tree in place, a simulation of the new OU against its current parent compares it with itself and should come back GO.
commands: orgshift simulate --from <target snapshot> --ou <ID of the new Production OU> --target-ou r-lark

phases.title: Rollback
phases.intro: Puts the OU tree back where it was. Built from the source attachments of the simulation.

steps.title: Recreate OU Production under OU Workloads (ou-lark-work) with its attachments
steps.detail: If the source OU Production (ou-lark-prod) still exists, skip the creation and reuse it. The policies still exist in the source organization.
commands: aws organizations create-organizational-unit --parent-id ou-lark-work --name "Production"   # only if Production (ou-lark-prod) was already deleted
aws organizations attach-policy --policy-id p-lark0005 --target-id <ID of the new Production OU>

steps.title: Move larkspur-data-prod (111111111118) back into Production
steps.detail: Reverse of the move; the original chain applies again.
commands: aws organizations move-account --account-id 111111111118 --source-parent-id <ID of the new Production OU> --destination-parent-id ou-lark-prod

steps.title: Move larkspur-payments-prod (111111111115) back into Production
steps.detail: Reverse of the move; the original chain applies again.
commands: aws organizations move-account --account-id 111111111115 --source-parent-id <ID of the new Production OU> --destination-parent-id ou-lark-prod

steps.title: Delete the new OUs once they are empty
steps.detail: Deepest first; the attachments go with them.

accounts.summary: 8 steps: 2 before the move (0 blocking), 2 to re-create, 1 for the move itself, 2 checks afterwards and 1 to roll back.

phases.title: Before the move: fix the blockers and make the decisions
phases.intro: Everything here is settled while the account is still at its current position. NO-GO steps block the move; REVIEW steps need a decision or a check by hand.

steps.title: Change the policy of arn:aws:s3:::larkspur-data-lake to cover the account's new OU path
steps.detail: Statement WorkloadAccountsWrite (Allow): it stops admitting the account's own principals (ForAnyValue:StringLike aws:PrincipalOrgPaths o-larkspur0001/r-lark/ou-lark-work/*); inside one account an identity policy can still grant the access, so whether anything breaks depends on policies this check does not read. Change the policy to name the destination organization (or both, for the transition) before the move.
steps.finding: Bucket policy of arn:aws:s3:::larkspur-data-lake ties access to organization identity that changes with the move
commands: aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket larkspur-data-lake --query Policy --output text > larkspur-data-lake-policy.json
# edit the condition on the organization path so it also covers the account's new path o-larkspur0001/r-lark/ou-lark-prod/

steps.title: Keep or replace stack StackSet-larkspur-baseline-roles-99ef627b-e471-7169-1578-5f22b2eda054 before StackSet larkspur-baseline-roles deletes it
steps.detail: StackSet larkspur-baseline-roles is service-managed with automatic deployment on and RetainStacksOnAccountRemoval off. When an account is removed from a target organization or OU, StackSets deletes its stack instances and their resources: here AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy x1, AWS::IAM::Role x3. Whatever in the account uses them stops working at that moment, and the resources are not there for a rollback either. Before the move, either turn RetainStacksOnAccountRemoval on for the StackSet (the stack then stays in the account, detached from the StackSet and no longer updated) or make sure the destination deploys an equivalent. Turning retention on is a setting of the whole StackSet and applies to every account that leaves its targets from then on.
steps.finding: StackSet instance StackSet-larkspur-baseline-roles-99ef627b-e471-7169-1578-5f22b2eda054 is deleted when the account leaves the StackSet's target OUs (ou-lark-work): 4 resource(s)
commands: aws cloudformation describe-stack-resources --stack-name StackSet-larkspur-baseline-roles-99ef627b-e471-7169-1578-5f22b2eda054 --region us-east-1 --query 'StackResources[].[ResourceType,LogicalResourceId,PhysicalResourceId]' --output table   # in the account: what the instance contains
# to keep the stack in the account when it leaves (add --capabilities and --parameters as the StackSet needs them):

evidence.note:
region us-east-1, status UPDATE_COMPLETE, 4 resource(s): AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy x1, AWS::IAM::Role x3
provenance: service-managed StackSet (high confidence): the stack ID is listed as an instance of StackSet larkspur-baseline-roles (permission model SERVICE_MANAGED, administered from 111111111111)
StackSet larkspur-baseline-roles: service-managed, auto-deployment true, retain stacks on account removal false, targets ou-lark-work; the stack ID is one of the StackSet's instances

phases.title: Before the move: re-create what does not travel
phases.intro: Shares, delegations, permission sets and stacks that are scoped to the account's current position do not follow it. Prepare the replacements now so nothing is interrupted.

steps.title: Re-share larkspur-workload-prefix-lists with the account directly: ec2:PrefixList
steps.detail: Owner 111111111112 shares larkspur-workload-prefix-lists (ec2:PrefixList) with arn:aws:organizations::111111111111:ou/o-larkspur0001/ou-lark-work today. After the move those principals no longer cover the account. Ask the owner to add account 111111111118 as a principal before the move so nothing attached to these resources is interrupted.
steps.finding: Networking share larkspur-workload-prefix-lists is lost: ec2:PrefixList

evidence.note:
owner 111111111112; principals: OU ou-lark-work; allow external principals false
ec2:PrefixList  arn:aws:ec2:us-east-1:111111111112:prefix-list/pl-071c30c49f742a6da

steps.title: Replace what StackSet larkspur-baseline-roles deploys into the account
steps.detail: Service-managed StackSets deploy by OU. Audit and break-glass IAM roles for workload accounts. Check what those stacks provide (roles, Config recorders, GuardDuty membership) before moving. The workloads check lists the instances found in this account and what each contains. Decide: redeploy the template by hand in the account, add the account to a self-managed StackSet, or accept the loss.
steps.finding: StackSet larkspur-baseline-roles stops targeting the account; stack instances are deleted from the account
commands: aws cloudformation describe-stack-set --stack-set-name larkspur-baseline-roles --query StackSet.TemplateBody --output text

evidence.note: admin 111111111111; targets OUs ou-lark-work accounts ; regions us-east-1; auto-deployment true; retain on removal false

phases.title: The move
phases.intro: One Organizations call, or the Account Factory flow when Control Tower governs the account.

steps.title: Moved together with OU Production
steps.detail: The account does not move on its own; the move steps are in the OU part of the runbook.

phases.title: After the move: checks
phases.intro: Confirm what the simulation predicted and finish what could only be done once the account is at its new position.

steps.title: Confirm share larkspur-workload-prefix-lists still reaches the account
steps.detail: Inside one organization no invitation is needed. The ec2:PrefixList should still be listed and the attachments that use them should still work.
steps.finding: Networking share larkspur-workload-prefix-lists is lost: ec2:PrefixList

steps.title: Confirm what became of stack StackSet-larkspur-baseline-roles-99ef627b-e471-7169-1578-5f22b2eda054
steps.detail: With retention on, the stack is still there and no longer belongs to the StackSet; with retention off, it and its resources are gone and whatever replaced them has to be in place.
steps.finding: StackSet instance StackSet-larkspur-baseline-roles-99ef627b-e471-7169-1578-5f22b2eda054 is deleted when the account leaves the StackSet's target OUs (ou-lark-work): 4 resource(s)

phases.title: Rollback
phases.intro: If something breaks, this puts the account back where it was. Built from the source policy chain of the simulation.

steps.title: Rolled back together with OU Production
steps.detail: The rollback of the OU recreates the original OUs and moves every account back; the account's own policies to re-attach are listed below.
